result.instructions: Tools for Detectify, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which vulnerabilities are still open with high severity on our production assets?"; "Show me the scan status and next scheduled scan for each scan profile."; "List the new vulnerabilities found in the last 7 days, grouped by asset.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Detectify data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run detectify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run detectify_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run detectify_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. detectify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: detectify_list_assets
tools.title: List root assets
tools.description: List the root assets (domains, IPs, hosts) of the team with their tokens. Start here to find an asset_token. Paged: pass next_marker back as marker. API v2: GET /assets/.

marker.description: Continue from the `next_marker` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

from.description: Only assets created after this timestamp.

include_subdomains.description: true = include subdomains at every level of the hierarchy.

tools.name: detectify_list_subdomains
tools.title: List subdomains of an asset
tools.description: List the subdomains found under one root asset. API v2: GET /assets/{assetToken}/subdomains/.

marker.description: Continue from the `next_marker` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: detectify_get_asset_settings
tools.title: Get asset (domain) settings
tools.description: Get the domain settings of one asset: scanning and monitoring options for that domain. Use the domain token the API returns for the asset. API v2: GET /domains/{domainToken}/settings/.

domain_token.description: The domain token of the asset.

tools.name: detectify_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the asset groups of the team with their group tokens. API v2: GET /groups/.

tools.name: detectify_list_group_members
tools.title: List group members
tools.description: List the assets that belong to one group. API v2: GET /groups/{groupToken}/members/.

tools.name: detectify_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the users of the Detectify team with their role. API v2: GET /members/.

tools.name: detectify_list_scan_profiles
tools.title: List scan profiles
tools.description: List all application scan profiles of the team with their scan_profile_token. API v2: GET /profiles/.

tools.name: detectify_list_scan_profiles_for_asset
tools.title: List scan profiles for an asset
tools.description: List the scan profiles that scan one asset. API v2: GET /profiles/{assetToken}/.

annotations.title: List scan profiles for an asset

tools.name: detectify_get_scan_profile_settings
tools.title: Get scan profile settings
tools.description: Get the settings of one application scan profile: scan region, requests per second, blacklisted and whitelisted paths, report lifespan. Credentials are not returned in clear. API v2: GET /profiles/{scanProfileToken}/settings/.

tools.name: detectify_get_scan_status
tools.title: Get scan status
tools.description: Get the status of the latest application scan of one scan profile: status, started, ended, error, warnings. API v2: GET /scans/{scanProfileToken}/.

tools.name: detectify_get_scan_schedule
tools.title: Get scan schedule
tools.description: Get the recurring scan schedule of one scan profile: frequency, first_scan, next_scan. API v2: GET /scanschedules/{scanProfileToken}/.

tools.name: detectify_list_vulnerabilities
tools.title: List vulnerabilities
tools.description: List vulnerability findings with filters: severity, status, scan source, asset, scan profile, group, host and creation or update time. Paged: pass next_marker back as marker. Use it for the main 'what is open' questions. API v2: GET /vulnerabilities/.

host.description: Only these hosts (a domain or an IP address).

created_after.description: Created at or after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Created at or before this timestamp.

updated_after.description: Updated at or after this timestamp.

marker.description: Continue from the `next_marker` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: detectify_get_vulnerability
tools.title: Get a vulnerability
tools.description: Get one vulnerability by its UUID, with the affected asset, request and response details, CVSS scores and remediation text. API v2: GET /vulnerabilities/uuid/{vulnerabilityUUID}/.

tools.name: detectify_set_vulnerability_status
tools.title: Set a vulnerability status
tools.description: Mark one vulnerability as accepted risk, false positive or fixed (set = true), or remove that mark (set = false). This changes the status shown to the whole team. Repeating the same call is safe. API v2: POST /vulnerabilities/uuid/{vulnerabilityUUID}/(un)set<status>/.

status.description: The status to set or unset.

set.description: true = set the status, false = remove it.
